title: A superhero opera?? I didn’t know I needed this until now. #MetOperaP...
transcript: A superhero opera. As a newer opera fan, I never would have expected to see comic books and opera in the same sentence. And yet somehow the Metropolitan Opera made it not just work but feel like it was always meant to be. The Amazing Adventures of Cavalier and Clay is based on the pole surprise winning novel and tells the story of two Jewish cousins in 1939 who create a comic book superhero to fight back against tyranny. It's about family, love, loss, queer identity and the power of imagination. This production is bold and visually stunning and the storytelling is so clear. I didn't even feel like I needed the captions and the projections, effects and scene changes made it feel almost cinematic. It's a show that's gonna have you on the edge of your seat. This is a must see at the met this winter, especially if you've been curious about opera but didn't know where to start. Cavalier and Clay returns February 17th through the 21st. And you can get your tickets at met opera.org or the Met Opera app. What a special, special, special, special light.
